**Group members:** Dhriti Iyer (di2251), Michelle Jerry (msj2167), Shaka Ramanathan (sr4354), & Anya Jacoby (abj2136)

**Tentative project title:**
Rats, Rent, and Where to Live: A Data-Driven Apartment Search

**Motivation for this project:**
Next year, we will be graduating with the intention of staying here in New York City! We hope to find a happy home amongst the five boroughs and we'd quite like that home to be rat-free (rat-light it needed). Rats are a common NYC reality, but their distribution varies: we want to use public rodent data to see which neighbourhoods have the biggest and smallest problems, and whether paying more rent actually gets you fewer rats. Then, we will combine that with budget and commute to find places we want to live in!

**Planned timeline:**
*Week 1 (Nov 23 - Nov 27):* 
We intend to use this week to identify the variables necessary to complete our analysis from the datasets and combine and clean the data. We will code the initial data visualizations to get an idea of what the results may be and how to refine our methods for more useful results. We will then clean up the code and visuals so that they are easy to interpret for viewers. At the end of this week, we will draft the following sections of the report: overview of project goals and motivations, related work, initial questions, data cleaning, and initial exploratory analysis. 
*Week 2 (Nov 30 - Dec 4):*
We intend to use this week to analyze the data we collected and build the website. At the end of this week, we will draft the following sections of the report: complete data cleaning and exploratory analysis. 
*Week 3 (Dec 7 - Dec 12):*
We intend to use this week to complete our report and website, record our webpage and screencast, and complete the peer assessment.
